description: This file implements back-end APIs for the COSA Data Model library, specifically for GatewayInfo object. It includes functions to get parameter values (boolean, integer, unsigned long, string) related to gateway information. Currently, most retrieval functions are placeholders, with the string retrieval function providing specific data via external functions. The file also contains license headers and descriptive comments.

methods.name: BOOL GatewayInfo_GetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL * pBool)
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for GatewayInfo object; currently not implemented, returns FALSE.

methods.name: BOOL GatewayInfo_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value; currently not implemented, returns FALSE.

methods.name: BOOL GatewayInfo_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value; currently not implemented, returns FALSE.

methods.name: ULONG GatewayInfo_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value such as ManufacturerOUI, ProductClass, or SerialNumber via external functions. Returns 0 on success, -1 if parameter is unsupported, or 1 if buffer is too small.
